# `aitbc system cat`

Display the systemd unit file for a service.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system cat [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | yes | Service to show unit file for |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system cat --service <service>
```
